reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Provider v1beta3 schema: allowed values changed: `spec.type`", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: Two new allowed values (otel, zulip) are accepted for spec.type; no existing value is removed, so existing resources are unaffected.

proposed.statement: The Provider v1beta3 spec.type enum gains the values "otel" and "zulip"; no values were removed.
